notes.title: Changes to the release plans & March 25 Development Update
notes.content:
Hey everyone, some pretty important news for you today, so make sure to read the entire post!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43165383/752c33338069b18ee18987f230058d95ffc3afb2.png[/img]

First of all, let's get the big news out of the way - [i]Tune in to the show[/i] will be split into two parts. With the release of Episode 9 in May, the first half of the story will be marked as complete, and the 2nd half of the story will be covered in [i]Tune in to the show Part 2[/i], which is going to be a separate game. This wasn't the original plan, and I didn't want to split the game into seasons like most other developers do, but it's become clear that it's the only feasible way to go about it financially. The situation is quite simple - if I don't release Part 2 as a separate game, I'll most likely run out of money before the game can be completed. My other project, [i]An Evening of Wonders[/i], turned out to be a complete flop, and I'd rather focus on [i]Tune in to the show[/i] than gamble on another side project doing better to fund the development. I know this isn't great news, but it is what it is, and I hope you can understand my perspective.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43165383/84b34861b6e336160c27805209c6b5f2cd0cf570.png[/img]

So, how is it going to work? When Episode 9 releases in May, this game will be marked as complete. The future episodes will be a part of [i]Tune in to the show Part 2[/i], which is going to be a separate game on Steam. You'll be able to import your saves from Part 1 or just choose which girls you're romancing with a short quiz if you don't want to import saves. I'll create a store page for Part 2 soon so that you can add it to your wishlists before Part 1 is finished. I think that Part 2 will also be released in Early Access this year, once Episode 10 is ready (and it's going to be bigger than usual Episodes to start strong).

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43165383/f35603d0774ff3ad3bdc8abed3668aaefa23b84a.png[/img]

Now, onto the usual stuff - I'm currently working on Episode 9, and it's going pretty well so far. A lot of the writing is done already, and it seems that this update will be one of the longest ones yet. The renders are coming along nicely too, and I'll start working on the first animations soon. If you're interested in Diana, you'll also end up meeting her older sister in this update. She can be seen in the render below :) The release date is set to May, and I don't anticipate any issues meeting it since everything's going smoothly.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43165383/b3c22c289c348a1b04d69eaba1bffeee8b800d00.png[/img]

That's all for this post. I hope you're all doing well, and I'll see you in the next development update. Thank you for playing the game, reading, and your understanding,

RobertDeadth

notes.title: April Development Update
notes.content:
Hey everyone, it's time for a quick development update!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43165383/07d9becced6079c5c6a4a239b2053b5ca800ffbe.png[/img]

Currently, I'm working on Episode 7 of the game. The work is going well and as of today, I have 3 major scenes left to be written, rendered, and animated before the release is ready. More than half of the scenes are already done and ready.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43165383/718bca3b11e6574eaa95fd35b9ddcc5907606b38.png[/img]

Episode 7 is going to be a little bit different - it'll feature one in-game day, but I'll also do my best to add an in-game gallery with this update! It's something that a lot of players have asked for, so I think it'll be worth the effort. It's my first time creating an in-game gallery, so I'll try to test it a bit before the release so hopefully, there won't be any bugs. Keep your fingers crossed! :)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43165383/0255755cc77a2df6632ab423e87e001f12ed2293.png[/img]

When can you expect Episode 7 to be released? It's a little difficult to estimate right now, but I'm aiming for the end of May/beginning of June. I'll write another development update post before the release so I should be able to give you a more specific estimate then.

That's all for this post, thank you so much for playing and reading, I hope you're all doing well,

RobertDeadth

notes.title: February Development Update
notes.content:
Hey everyone, it's time for the monthly development update!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43165383/bec0f2cdc3f459ec58fdb00df5109c694a55fb0d.png[/img]

I'm happy to say that the work is going very well and Episode 6 is almost ready for release! I'm currently working on the last scene of the update. I'm estimating that I need around a week more to finish rendering and writing the last scene. When all that is done, I'll take a couple of days to test if everything is working properly and once that is over, Episode 6 will be released!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43165383/19955baaad38b45b7268a53819e6776544c99b9f.png[/img]

Episode 6 will feature 2 full in-game days, so it's going to be a pretty big update. It'll also feature the first sex scene with two girls. I hope you're excited :)

Anyway, that's all for now. I'll see you again soon when Episode 6 releases! Thank you so much for playing the game and reading, I hope you're all doing well,

notes.title: Status update and an estimated release date
notes.content:
Hey there everyone! I thought it would be a good idea to give you all some new info :)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43165383/51dce779c2afa3ef861f958a0d226f14e06fbcc8.png[/img]

Recently, I've finished working on all of the story content that's going to be in the game when it releases in Early Access. Right now, I'm working on adding new animations to all of the game's sex scenes and implementing Steam achievements. The work is going really well and I expect to be done by the end of February.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43165383/76eead44e434c5b7cdb5d9b51749bee2e7b5bc74.png[/img]

[b]That's why I'm planning to release the game at the beginning of March, possibly on the 1st![/b] I'll announce the exact release date in a few weeks when I have everything completely ready and tested.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43165383/40ed57cbee8654b41cc04906b8a5ca24bdedacad.png[/img]

Thank you for your interest and see you next time,
RobertDeadth
